purpose: Document first-party parcel map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access/adapter qualification.
assessment: ArcGIS item metadata identifies owner SeattleData and states the service is a subset of King County assessor parcel polygons spatially filtered to the City of Seattle Central Geographic Database extent; its description notes the dataset extends north and south of the city. The layer is Polygon geometry, OBJECTID is its transport key and PIN its native parcel ID. A WGS84 point-intersection query at the ranked locator returned one full polygon (PIN 7974200250, OBJECTID 11343910) when requesting only OBJECTID,PIN. The repository ArcGIS adapter completed 13 bounded 0.001-degree grid/pan cells, forced three-row paging, 106 fresh exact native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source-binding checks (20/20 tests passed; 141 requests). Full geometries stayed in /tmp; the repository retains one point-hit feature. Independent Shapely 2.2.0/GEOS audit of all 106 temp polygons in EPSG:32610 found 106 valid/nonempty, zero exact duplicates, zero overlap pairs above 0.01 m², and zero operation errors. This is bounded sample evidence, not citywide completeness. The source layer is not a complete/legal city parcel registry, and its clipped spatial extent is distinct from the current Seattle city boundary. Exact overall completeness, parcel-ID uniqueness beyond the sample and legal boundary accuracy are unverified.
